description: This Java source file defines the MockACEDevice class, a mock device for testing or simulation purposes within a Zigbee-based system. It extends MockZigbeeDevice and implements several capabilities such as Tamperable, BatteryPowered, and MockSecurityController. The class manages clusters related to device functionality, including zone and ACE clusters, and provides methods to simulate device actions like arming and status polling, as well as handling tamper and battery status.

classes.name: MockACEDevice
